title: Listening Drill — School parcel collections — Trial review
description: Conversation about a trial. One synthetic recording, six questions. Recommended time: 7 minutes.

sections.title: School parcel collections — Trial review
sections.transcript:
HOST: You ran two introductory sessions on school parcel collections last week. What happened in the first one?

GUEST: On the first run, several people reported a problem with missing parcels. At first we wondered whether it was a problem with the instructions. A closer inspection revealed the fault: torn label.

HOST: What changed when you ran the session again?

GUEST: On each trial, we now keep a record of parcel size so changes can be compared. For the second trial we let everyone borrow claim ticket instead of bringing their own. That helped us keep the equipment as consistent as possible.

HOST: What should people who attended do now?

GUEST: Send any suggestions directly to the collection clerk before the next group arrives. The next group comes on Saturday, so we have time to compare notes beforehand.
